experience.description: Parent company that owns and operates four Ruby on Rails software businesses: Reservation Genie (tour and charter reservations), 88 Restaurants (restaurant management), Tally Meals (Greek house meal management), and Austin City Guide (a high-traffic city guide and CMS). Joined in 2016 and have since architected, rebuilt, and operated all four Rails codebases, from schema design and payments to production servers and deployment.

products.name: Reservation Genie
bullets: Rebuilt a legacy Rails 3 reservation platform from greenfield on Ruby on Rails 8, PostgreSQL, and Hotwire, leading a small team to deliver reservations, rentals, private charters, and digital waivers at 50,000+ reservations a year.

Built the payment system behind every booking on the Stripe API (charges, webhooks, refunds) plus an ActiveMerchant gateway layer that lets clients bring their own payment processor, processing ~$5M a year in payment volume.

Increased client reservations 20% by launching white-labeled booking subdomains (e.g. book.clientdomain.com) with host-aware routing and cookie scoping, so UTM and Google Ads attribution survives from the client's site through purchase and clients can see which channels convert.

products.name: 88 Restaurants
bullets: Split the restaurant product out of the shared Reservation Genie codebase into a greenfield multi-tenant platform spanning online ordering, reservations, live table management, loyalty, and marketing automation: 4,400+ commits across 280K lines of application code, a 140-table MySQL schema, and a 615-file RSpec suite, owning the stack from schema design to production servers.

Processed 8 figures in payment volume by architecting the online ordering system end to end: Stripe checkout and refunds, Uber Direct delivery integration, order scheduling, gift cards, and a full catering system.

Built live table management with real-time table-state synchronization across every device in the restaurant over ActionCable WebSockets, a drag-and-drop floor-plan editor, and an availability engine, giving front-of-house staff a single live view of the floor.

products.name: Tally Meals
bullets: Replaced a failing legacy PHP API and React Native platform for Greek house meal management by leading a small team through a ground-up Ruby on Rails rebuild, now serving 100+ houses across 35+ universities.

Shipped iOS and Android apps from a single Rails codebase using Hotwire Native, letting members reserve meals and late plates against chef-published menus with per-member allergy and dietary tracking, meal-plan limits, and printable kitchen prep lists.

Carried every client's historical data through the replatform by converting the legacy database to PostgreSQL, reverse-engineering the old schema and migrating chapters, members, meal plans, and reservation history into the new Rails domain model.

products.name: Austin City Guide
bullets: Achieved #1 Google rankings for competitive local keywords like "things to do in Austin" through on-page SEO, technical optimization, and page-speed work after rebuilding the decade-old .NET site from the ground up in Ruby on Rails.
Built in-house analytics in Rails to measure real user behavior across the site's highest-traffic pages.
Increased click-through rates on the highest-traffic pages with an A/B split-testing system in Rails that tested page layouts against live traffic.

skills.items: Ruby, Ruby on Rails (3 – 8), Active Record, Active Job, ActionCable, Action Mailer, Active Merchant, Stripe, RSpec, Sidekiq, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, REST APIs, Twilio, Postmark, Uber Direct
Hotwire (Turbo & Stimulus), Hotwire Native (iOS & Android), JavaScript, TailwindCSS, Bootstrap
Linux, Kamal, Dokku, Nginx, GitHub Actions
